## User outcome

What should a person be able to accomplish?

## Relevant requirements

List applicable `MFX-*` identifiers from `docs/product/PRODUCT-REQUIREMENTS.md`, or explain why a new requirement is needed.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior. Include normal, failure, and empty states.

## Public-contract impact

Does this change the project format, interaction runtime, static bundle, API, role model, sharing policy, or plugin contract?

## Security, privacy, and accessibility

State access-control effects, data handling, keyboard/focus behavior, semantic labels, and motion concerns.

## Acceptance evidence

Describe fixtures, unit/integration/browser tests, and documentation updates that would prove completion.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches were considered and why are they not preferred?
